title: L2-L3 and L4-L5 facet normal load under axial compression, neutral and extended (pressure film)

quantity.name: facet normal load
quantity.definition: facet normal load per facet (left, right) = contact area x average pressure from Fuji Prescale film; mean over the specimens of each level (3 per level), no SD reported

source.authors: Lorenz M, Patwardhan A, Vanderby R Jr
source.sample: 6 fresh human lumbar FSUs (3 L2-L3, 3 L4-L5) from autopsy, tested within 12 h of death then frozen; ligaments and capsules intact; discs Nachemson grade 2-3

protocol.summary: Instron 1122; FSU potted in aluminium cups (end-plate support only), top cup on a universal joint. Preconditioning: 70 kg (686.7 N) at 1 mm/min, 2-3 times. Compressive loads 196.2, 392.4, 686.7, 1373.4 N (20-140 kg) at 1 mm/min, held >=2 min (load-hold-unload, >=5 min rest). Neutral: end plates parallel, load through disc centroid. Extension: segment extended by hand to end of compliant range (6-8 deg), load through mid-sagittal posterior walls of the vertebral bodies (small extension moment proportional to eccentricity, via 5-mm-radius disc). Posterior capsules incised to insert 12x25 mm Fuji Prescale film packets.
how_to_simulate: Fix the caudal vertebra of an L2-L3 or L4-L5 FSU; keep ligaments, cut posterior capsule if modelled
Neutral: apply 1373.4 N axial compression through the disc centroid with end plates parallel
Extension: rotate the segment 6-8 deg into extension, then apply 1373.4 N through the posterior walls of the vertebral bodies (allow settling)
Report normal contact force of left and right facets (N)
protocol.notes: Means of 3 specimens per level; no spread reported. Film accuracy <10% (manufacturer). Tables 3-4 (right facet after left facetectomy) not extracted: outside card scope. In Table 2 the L4-L5 neutral 686.7 N total (22.6) does not equal left+right (62.6) as printed.

extraction.check_notes: Scanned PDF; tables read from 220 dpi render. Review (Ghezelbash 2020b Table 2) values at 1373.4 N confirmed exactly: L2-L3 neutral 56.4/62.9, extension 131.4/105.9; L4-L5 neutral 73.6/38.6, extension 113.9/60.8 N. Review gave no n: n = 3 FSUs per level.

pass_rule.rule: no spread reported (n=3 per level): compare within +-50% of the mean; widen for film bias
